name: Why does my kitchen sink smell bad even after it drains?

mainEntity.name: Why does my kitchen sink smell bad even after it drains?

acceptedAnswer.text: A lingering bad smell after a kitchen sink drains often indicates that odor-causing bacteria and decaying food particles are still present within the drain pipes or the garbage disposal. These materials can accumulate on pipe walls or in the disposal unit, leading to foul odors. Professional cleaning can thoroughly remove these residues, while regular cleaning of the disposal and flushing with hot water and baking soda can help maintain freshness between services.
acceptedAnswer.description: Lingering odors after draining often point to decaying food and bacteria in the pipes or garbage disposal. Professional cleaning can resolve this.
